title: GLM-5.2
before: GLM-4.5 had established Zhipu in the open agentic tier.
problem: Open models needed both scale and long context to stay relevant.
breakthrough: A very large open MoE with million-token context under MIT.
why: Another Chinese lab at the open frontier as the Western open ecosystem thinned.
next: Continued competition with Qwen, Kimi and DeepSeek.
inherits: A crowded, largely Chinese open frontier.
